title: Every profile has an @handle, unique and editable in settings, shown wherever the person shows themselves

tasks.title: Handles in the database, assignment, validation and the API
The Handle field in settings and @handle beside the name

acs.text: WHEN a person's profile is created, or an existing profile without a handle is read, THE SYSTEM SHALL give it a handle made from its name (lower-case Latin letters, digits and `_`; a name with none of those gives `learner`), with a number added when that handle is taken; every profile's handle is unique, ignoring case
scenarios: AC-001 a handle on first use

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in viewer sends `PATCH /api/v1/profiles/me` with `{handle}` THE SYSTEM SHALL put it in canonical form first (Unicode NFKC, lower case, a leading `@` dropped, at most 64 characters read) and then accept it only when it is 3–30 characters of `a–z`, `0–9` and `_`, starts with a letter, and is not reserved; an invalid handle answers 400 `profile.handle_invalid`, a handle another profile has answers 409 `profile.handle_taken`, and nothing else changes

THE SYSTEM SHALL include the handle in every profile it answers (`GET /api/v1/profiles/me`, `/profiles/{profileId}`, the suggestions) and in each post's author, and `GET /api/v1/profiles/by-handle/{handle}` SHALL answer the profile with that handle (canonical form, any case) or 404 `profile.not_found`

WHEN a viewer opens `/social/settings?tab=profile` THE SYSTEM SHALL show a Handle field, labelled above it, with `@` before it and the rules under it; Save saves it with the name and bio, and an invalid or taken handle is said next to the field, in the interface's language, without losing what was typed
WHEN a profile page or a post's author line is shown THE SYSTEM SHALL show the handle as `@handle` beside the name, as text (never as markup), left to right inside a Hebrew interface
